name: Isen (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Isen town emblem in white: a stylised device of two winged lobes enclosing stylised characters.
history: Municipal flag of Isen, a town in Kagoshima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field.

features.role: Isen town emblem — a stylised device of two winged lobes enclosing stylised characters
